package com.acme.common.validation;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.NullSource;

@DisplayName("PostalCodeValidator")
class PostalCodeValidatorTest {

    @ParameterizedTest
    @CsvSource({
            "SG, 018956, true",
            "sg, ' 018956 ', true",
            "SG, 01895, false",
            "MY, 50450, true",
            "GB, SW1A 1AA, true",
            "GB, 12345, false",
            "US, 10001, false"
    })
    void validatesPerCountry(final String country, final String code, final boolean expected) {
        assertThat(PostalCodeValidator.isValid(country, code)).isEqualTo(expected);
    }

    @org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
    void nullCountryIsInvalid() {
        assertThat(PostalCodeValidator.isValid(null, "018956")).isFalse();
    }

    @org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
    void nullPostalCodeIsInvalid() {
        assertThat(PostalCodeValidator.isValid("SG", null)).isFalse();
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @NullSource
    @CsvSource({"XX"})
    void unsupportedCountries(final String country) {
        assertThat(PostalCodeValidator.isSupported(country)).isFalse();
    }

    @org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
    void singaporeIsSupported() {
        assertThat(PostalCodeValidator.isSupported("sg")).isTrue();
    }
}
